faqs.question: What is the difference between the Builder Package and Channel Partner (CP) Package?
faqs.answer: The Builder Package (₹2 LAC for 3 Months) is engineered for builders and real estate developers looking for a comprehensive 3-month flagship launch engine. The Channel Partner (CP) Package is tailored specifically for real estate channel partners with 3 flexible options based on property ticket size (₹75k for projects upto ₹80L, ₹90k for ₹80L-₹1.5Cr, and ₹1.5L for ₹1.5Cr-₹3Cr).

faqs.question: What is included in the ₹2 Lac Complete Builder Marketing Package?
faqs.answer: This package provides a comprehensive 3-month growth engine for builders, developers, and large real estate launches. It includes WhatsApp Marketing + Quality Data, Leads Calling, Project Website & Landing Page, Meta & Youtube & Google Ads, Reels & Short-Form Content, AI Promotional Videos, Associated Channels support, and Campaign Monitoring & Optimization.

faqs.question: Does the fee include advertising budget or is it separate?
faqs.answer: The fee covers full agency execution, creative production, video generation, landing page development, tele-calling lead qualification, and strategic management for the full 3-month cycle. Ad spend (paid directly to Meta and Google) is separate so you maintain 100% control over your daily ad budget without markups.

faqs.question: How does the Associated Channels collaboration work?
faqs.answer: Through Associated Channels, we provide verified real estate marketing expertise, structured channel partner alignment, broker channel activation, and proven lead qualification funnels designed to deliver more quality leads, stronger brand presence, better project visibility, and end-to-end sales support.

faqs.question: How does the Lead Verification and Qualification support work?
faqs.answer: We ensure your sales team never wastes time on junk or fake inquiries. Our dedicated qualification team calls and WhatsApp-verifies every incoming inquiry to confirm the buyer's budget, preferred unit configuration (e.g., 2 BHK, 3 BHK, Penthouse), location interest, and buying timeframe before handing them over or booking a site visit.

faqs.question: How quickly will our project website and campaigns go live?
faqs.answer: We execute rapidly. Your custom project landing page, ad creatives, WhatsApp funnels, and campaigns will be fully configured and live within 5 to 7 business days from onboarding and collateral collection.

faqs.question: Do we get complete ownership of the landing page, videos, and leads?
faqs.answer: Yes, 100%. All landing pages, domain configurations, AI promotional videos, ad creative designs, and prospective buyer databases belong exclusively to your firm.

faqs.question: How do I get started?
faqs.answer: Select your desired package (Builder Package or Channel Partner Plan), click 'Select Plan & Get Started' to initiate onboarding online, message us on WhatsApp, or call our team directly at 9096090701. We will schedule a kickoff session within 24 hours.
